parts.text: Generate a short sample interview report for a frontend developer role. Self description: I know React. Job description: Frontend developer needed.

matchScore.description: The score between 0 to 100 indicating how well the candidate's profile matches the job description

question.description: The technical Questions asked in the interview

intention.description: The intention of interviewer behind this question

answer.description: How to answer the question, what points to cover, what approach to take etc.

technicalQuestions.description: Technical questions that can be asked in the interview and their intention and how to answer them

question.description: The behavioral Questions asked in the interview

intention.description: The intention of interviewer behind this question

answer.description: How to answer the question, what points to cover, what approach to take etc.

behavioralQuestions.description: Behavior questions that can be asked in the interview and their intention and how to answer them

skill.description: The skill in which the candidate is lacking

severity.description: The severity of this skill gap

skillGaps.description: List of skill gaps in the candidate's profile along with their severity

day.description: The day number in preparartion plan, starting from 1

focus.description: The main focus of this day in the preparation plan e.g data structures, mock interviews

tasks.description: List of Tasks to be done on this days to follow the preparation plan

preparationPlan.description: A day-wise preparation plan for candidate to follow in order to prepare for interview effectively

title.description: The title of the job for which the interview report is generated
